title: Restriction and covering-sieve locality of proper-support sections
statement: Let f:X->Y be separated and locally of finite type and F a sheaf of Lambda-modules [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Proper support of sections of F(X_V) over V [def-cbc-etale-section-proper-support] is preserved by restriction along any map W->V in Y_et, and can be tested after restriction along every arrow of a covering sieve on V.

proof.text: The geometric-germ cocone relation identifies vanishing after restriction with vanishing at the composed geometric point. Thus the support of a restriction is the inverse image of the original closed support.

The square of X_W, X_V, W and V is Cartesian, by cancellation of the defining pullback squares. Transport closed-support properness across its canonical pullback isomorphism using the closed proper-image assertion.

Apply the base-change clause of closed support locality for restriction. A covering sieve contains a jointly surjective etale cover; apply its descent clause to that cover and the same support calculation.

lean.statement:
theorem properSupportSectionLocality (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] :
    (∀ (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
      (V W : Y.Etale) (h : W ⟶ V) s,
      SectionHasProperSupport Λ F (f.Etale.obj V) (pullback.fst V.hom f) s →
      SectionHasProperSupport Λ F (f.Etale.obj W) (pullback.fst W.hom f)
        (F.obj.map (f.Etale.map h).op s)) ∧
    (∀ (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
      (V : Y.Etale) s (S : Sieve V), S ∈ Y.smallEtaleTopology V →
      (∀ (W : Y.Etale) (h : W ⟶ V), S h →
        SectionHasProperSupport Λ F (f.Etale.obj W) (pullback.fst W.hom f)
          (F.obj.map (f.Etale.map h).op s)) →
      SectionHasProperSupport Λ F (f.Etale.obj V) (pullback.fst V.hom f) s)
